name: polaris-slingshot
description: Slingshot SL experience: Next.js 15 web, Express API and React Native (Expo) mobile app.

scripts.dev: npm run dev:api & npm run dev:web
scripts.build: npm run build -w @slingshot/api && npm run build -w @slingshot/web
scripts.start: npm run start -w @slingshot/api & npm run start -w @slingshot/web
